spawn_spec.prompt:
TASK: Update `ui/src/lib/types.ts`, `ui/src/state/layout.ts`, `ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts`, and `ui/src/state/layout.test.ts` to use per-tab split trees based on `ui/src/state/paneTree.ts`.
REQUIREMENTS:
1. `TabPaneLayout = { root: PaneNode; activeLeafId: string | null; expandedLeafId: string | null; sessionIdsByLeafId: Record<string, string> }`
2. `LayoutState = { tabs: TerminalTab[]; activeTabId: string | null; layoutsByTabId: Record<string, TabPaneLayout> }`
3. Reducer actions must support:
   - `ADD_TAB(tab, sessionId, activate)`: creates a tab with a single leaf pane node in its `layoutsByTabId[tab.id]`.
   - `CLOSE_TAB(tabId, replacementTab)`: removes tab and its layout.
   - `ACTIVATE_TAB(tabId)`: activates tab.
   - `SPLIT_PANE(tabId, targetLeafId, direction, newLeafId, sessionId, position)`: splits ANY target pane in that tab horizontally or vertically.
   - `CLOSE_PANE(tabId, leafId)`: removes leaf from the tab's tree. If last pane is closed in the tab, closes the tab.
   - `FOCUS_PANE(tabId, leafId)`: updates activeLeafId in that tab.
   - `SET_PANE_RATIO(tabId, path, ratio)`: updates split ratio at path.
   - `SWAP_PANES(tabId, sourceLeafId, targetLeafId)`: swaps two pane positions in the tree (for drag-to-reorder).
4. Update `workspaceStore.ts` to integrate with the new layout actions and ensure backend session management cleans up doomed sessions when panes or tabs close.
5. Update `layout.test.ts` to assert all per-tab tree split, close, and ratio operations.
SCOPE: Edit `ui/src/lib/types.ts`, `ui/src/state/layout.ts`, `ui/src/state/workspaceStore.ts`, and `ui/src/state/layout.test.ts`.
STOP WHEN: `bun run --cwd ui test -- src/state/layout.test.ts src/state/workspaceStore.test.tsx` passes.
